name: Repair an accessible filter interaction
description: Repair a small static results page so filtering works through semantic form submission and remains inspectable in a bounded runtime receipt.
prompt: Repair `index.html` into an accessible benchmark-run filter page. Keep the supplied result rows, give the form an explicit accessible name, associate the Status label with the select, use a real submit button, and make the inline submit handler hide nonmatching rows while exposing the empty state when there are no matches. The interaction must work without pointer-only `onclick` handlers. Keep the document self-contained with no network resources. Run `npm test`; the fixture test simulates the submit path and checks the accessible markup. Then write `evidence/render.json` for the exact `index.html` bytes at 720x480@1 with no console errors or horizontal overflow. The receipt is deterministic runtime-contract evidence, not a screenshot or pixel-quality verdict. Do not modify `verify.test.mjs` or `package.json`.

benchmark.intent: Whether an agent can repair an accessible interaction so keyboard-submit behavior and semantic markup agree with a deterministic interaction contract.
benchmark.deliverable: A self-contained index.html with working submit filtering and a matching fixed-viewport render receipt.
